images.prompt: A balanced square four-panel editorial still illustration, with four equal independent views of exactly the same simple room in a two-by-two arrangement. Every panel uses the same slightly elevated camera looking from the near wall toward the far wall. A broad window is centered on the FAR wall, and the single entrance is on the NEAR wall at the right. Each panel contains exactly one small rectangular desk and two identical blue chairs. No people or other furniture. UPPER LEFT: desk near the far window, with a chair on each opposite side of the desk so their seats face one another across it. UPPER RIGHT: desk nearer the entrance in the near half of the room, with one chair on each opposite side facing the other across the desk. LOWER LEFT: desk near the far window, with both chairs side by side on the NEAR side of the desk so both seats face toward the window. LOWER RIGHT: desk in the near half near the entrance, with both chairs side by side on the NEAR side facing toward the window. Chair backs and seats must make their facing directions unmistakable. Keep the entrance and a walking strip unobstructed in all four views. Identical room geometry, desk size, chair size, colours, lighting and camera angle across panels; only desk position and chair arrangement differ. Generous equal pale margins and clear empty space at each panel's upper left for a later number. No arrows, numbers, letters, panel titles or highlighting of any arrangement.
invariants: Exactly four equally sized/equally treated panels and identical room topology
Exactly one desk and two chairs per panel; far window and near-right entrance visible
Panels 1/2 have chairs on opposite sides facing each other; panels 3/4 have side-by-side chairs facing the window
Panels 1/3 are window-side; panels 2/4 are entrance-side without blocking the entrance
All distinctions remain observable at 256px, without adding answer-bearing captions

markers.method: Add equally styled crisp black numbers with light backing locally, only after the unmarked room geometry passes inspection
markers.coordinates: Determine from the actual accepted panel margins, not from a fabricated image receipt

images.prompt: Exactly two adults at one ordinary public-service counter in a softly painted editorial scene. On the LEFT, a male staff member is clearly BEHIND the counter, with a small unlabelled computer and a simple work shelf behind him. On the RIGHT, a female visitor is clearly IN FRONT of the counter, holding one blank application form and one pen. The form has only a few empty boxes and lines, absolutely no writing or symbols. Both people are looking at the form and each other in a calm helpful interaction, but neither is writing and no completed form is present. Keep their bodies, connected hands, the pen and the single form easy to distinguish. Leave uncluttered background space above and to the left of the staff member's head for a later role arrow. Ordinary original adult faces and anatomically coherent hands. No third person, badges with text, books of instructions, speech bubbles, arrows or written answer clues.
invariants: Male staff member left/behind counter; female visitor right/in front
Visitor holds the only blank form and pen; neither person is writing
No filled-in form, printed words or other implied completed help
The locally marked staff role is recognizable at 512px and 256px

markers.target: Left staff member's head or shoulder
markers.method: Inspect the actual geometry, then add a crisp role arrow without covering a face, hand, pen or form
